citations.claim: Management reported stronger year-over-year iPhone 16 family performance in markets where Apple Intelligence was available than in markets where it was not.
citations.source_text: We did see that the markets where we had rolled out Apple intelligence that the year-over-year performance on the iPhone 16 family was stronger than those where Apple intelligence was not available.

citations.claim: Products revenue was $98 billion, up 2% year over year, driven by growth from iPad and Mac.
citations.source_text: Products revenue was $98 billion, up 2% year over year, driven by growth from iPad and Mac.

citations.claim: Services set an all‑time revenue record of $26.3 billion for the December quarter, growing 14% from a year ago.
citations.source_text: Turning to services, we set an all-time revenue record of $26.3 billion for the December quarter growing 14% from a year ago.

citations.claim: Apple reported Mac revenue of $9 billion for the December quarter, up 16% year over year; management attributed the growth to excitement around the latest Mac lineup.
citations.source_text: In Mac, revenue was $9 billion for the December quarter, 16% higher year over year driven by significant excitement around the world for our latest Mac lineup.

citations.claim: Wearables, Home and Accessories revenue was $11.7 billion, down 2% year‑over‑year.
citations.source_text: Wearables Home and Accessories revenue was $11.7 billion, down 2% year-over-year.

citations.claim: Greater China revenue was down 11% year over year for the quarter.
citations.source_text: If you look at our greater China revenue for the quarter, we were down 11% year over year.

citations.claim: Apple expects March-quarter total company revenue to grow low to mid-single digits year over year.
citations.source_text: With that headwind, we expect our March quarter total company revenue to grow low to mid-single digits year-over-year.

citations.claim: A significantly stronger dollar is expected to be a headwind, negatively impacting revenue by about 2.5 percentage points on a year‑over‑year basis.
citations.source_text: As a dollar is strengthened significantly, we expect foreign exchange to be a headwind and to have a negative impact on revenue of about 2.5 percentage points on a year-over-year basis.
